name: Punch Captions
description: High-retention captions over your talking-head clip: one to three words at a time in huge white Anton with a thick black outline, the key word swapped to yellow and tilted, little sticker pops (bolts, sparks, arrows) drawn in code, and punch-in zooms on the hits.
best_use_cases: Talking-head hooks for Shorts, Reels and TikTok
High-retention caption overlays on spoken clips
Emphasising key words with punch zooms and sticker pops
